decisions.reason: The perfect binder sits at the core of the firm's established finishing portfolio, the firm committed to it visibly with a dedicated page, and any weak results around 2020-2021 can plausibly be blamed on the temporary pandemic slump in print, so management persists.
The fully automatic binder fits the firm's announced direction toward integrated automation, which raises the justification pressure and public commitment behind it and makes a drop very unlikely.
The inline/nearline booklet maker is central to the digital print finishing strategy the firm has announced and shows no sign of withdrawal, so management keeps backing it.
